declaration.intent: Declare LifeForge as a Forge Stack consumer: a developmental biology simulator where cell differentiation is a classified claim (OPINION, reinforced via the Leighton Loop to FACT) rather than an instant threshold assignment, with a real hash-chained ledger and gated interventions.

spine_compliance.classify_datacube: IMPLEMENTED — cell fate proposals are OPINION-lens claims with explicit lambda, promoted to FACT only via sustained morphogen-signal reinforcement
spine_compliance.trust_score_leighton_weight: IMPLEMENTED — per-cell fate lambda decays/reinforces each tick per a fixed k, calibrated for this sim's tick cadence
spine_compliance.audit_chronoscribe: IMPLEMENTED, browser-local — hash-chained ledger (canonicalised JSON + SHA-256, same shape as genesis.py), not yet Ed25519-signed per entry
spine_compliance.act_hal: PARTIAL — interventions pass an egress gate check before firing; no tiered validator roles yet, single-operator only

known_gaps.ledger_signing: Ledger entries are hash-chained but not individually signed — integrity of the chain is verifiable, provenance of who ran the session is not yet.
known_gaps.scope_cut: Original LifeForge features (pan/zoom, nervous system firing, multiple visualisation modes, experiment presets) were deliberately cut from this pass to prioritise depth on stack integration over feature parity.
